unity-verifier.description: Runs the project's Unity harness (rules, recompile, EditMode tests, Play mode smoke) against the open Editor and reports results. Strictly read-only — never edits code; any file change is detected by the workflow guard and voids the run. Use after an implementation step to get an independent pass/fail verdict.

claude.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob

unity-reviewer.description: Reviews the current C# diff against this project's Unity coding rules (SRP, file length, encapsulation with SerializeField, comment and Debug.Log rules when enabled, no LINQ/string concat/GetComponent in Update, CompareTag) and for correctness bugs. Read-only. Use after implementation, in parallel with unity-verifier.

claude.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob

plan-loader.description: Reads an approved plan.md and returns its key facts (summary, complexity, test assemblies, smoke expectations) as structured data. Read-only, has no shell and no write tools. Used by the unity-feature workflow when args.planFile is given.

claude.tools: Read

run-log-writer.description: Writes the judgment parts of a harness run report (title, summary, plan notes, per-file descriptions, noise suggestions) as notes; the unity-harness CLI renders report.md from them plus changes.json and the run facts. Also fixes the notes when an audit lists discrepancies. Only writes inside the given run directory.

claude.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob

run-log-auditor.description: Independently audits the judged parts of a harness run report.md (file descriptions, summary, plan notes, noise suggestions) against changes.diff and facts.json, then writes audit.md. Never edits report.md or project files.

claude.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob

creative-director.description: Highest creative authority for a Unity game: pillars, core fantasy, tone and scope arbitration; use for vision decisions, pillar conflicts and the CD-PILLARS gate.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, WebSearch

technical-director.description: Owns the technical vision of a Unity game: architecture, packages, render pipeline, performance budgets and technical risk; use for technology choices, cross-system conflicts and the TD-FEASIBILITY gate.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, WebSearch

producer.description: Owns schedule and scope for a Unity game: sprints, milestones, risks and cross-department coordination; use for planning questions and the PR-SCOPE, PR-EPIC and PR-SPRINT gates.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

game-designer.description: Designs the rules, loops, systems, balance and economy of a Unity game and writes the brief or GDDs; use for mechanics questions and design documents.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, WebSearch

art-director.description: Owns the visual identity of a Unity game: art direction, asset specs and import settings, UI visual design; use for visual decisions and the AD-CONCEPT-VISUAL gate.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, WebSearch

lead-programmer.description: Owns code-level architecture and review for a Unity project (assemblies, interfaces, standards, refactoring); use to plan a story implementation, review code, and for the LP-CODE-REVIEW gate.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

qa-lead.description: Owns test strategy and the test-evidence gate for a Unity project (EditMode tests, Play mode screenshots, bug severity); use for testability reviews and the QL-STORY-READY and QL-TEST-COVERAGE gates.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

qa-tester.description: Writes EditMode NUnit tests, manual test cases, regression checklists and bug reports for a Unity project; use when a story needs tests or a bug needs a report.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

gameplay-programmer.description: Implements gameplay mechanics in Unity C# from stories and design docs: data-driven, testable, verified with unity-harness; use for player systems, rules and game-loop features.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

ui-programmer.description: Implements Unity menus, HUD and screens (uGUI or UI Toolkit) from specs, with data binding, accessibility and localization readiness; use for UI stories.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

ai-programmer.description: Implements enemy and NPC behaviour in Unity: state machines or behaviour trees, AI Navigation, perception and group tactics; use for AI stories.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

engine-programmer.description: Implements the core framework of a Unity game: bootstrap, scene and resource loading, pooling, memory, profiling hooks and editor tooling; use for foundation and performance-critical stories.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

unity-specialist.description: Authority on Unity patterns, packages and project settings (MonoBehaviour vs DOTS, Input System, uGUI vs UI Toolkit, URP); use to review Unity-specific code or choose a subsystem, and to know which unity-*-specialist to bring in.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

unity-ui-specialist.description: Unity UI expert for UI Toolkit and uGUI architecture, data binding, screen stacks, gamepad/touch navigation and UI performance; use for complex UI work.

claude.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash

unity-dots-specialist.description: Unity DOTS expert for Entities, Jobs, Burst, baking and Entities Graphics; use when a system needs ECS-scale performance.
